[.walkthrough]
.Check a view and look at an issue
. Switch to *Test* mode and click *Accessibility Checker* in the toolbar.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/01-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/01-open.jpg"]
. Click *Check*. The [.walkthrough-look]#results# list errors and warnings, grouped by rule, with the component each one is about.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/02-check.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/02-check.jpg"]
. Click an issue for its details: what's wrong, how to fix it, and the HTML it's about.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/03-issue.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/accessibility-checker/03-issue.jpg"]
